# n8n_data_table (Data Source)

Fetches a single n8n data table by ID or name. When using ID, the API's GET /data-tables/{id} endpoint is used. When using name, the LIST endpoint is used with client-side filtering.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Data table identifier. Either `id` or `name` must be specified.
- `name` (String) Data table name. Either `id` or `name` must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `project_id` (String) ID of the project this table belongs to
